segments.name: Telecom Division
segments.description: International voice, SMS and connectivity services for telecom carriers, businesses and end users.
segments.evidence: Our Telecom Division, which represents the majority of current operations and accounted for 91% of our revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025, offers Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), SMS, proprietary Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, and international fiber-optic connectivity through its subsidiaries

segments.name: Fintech Business Line
segments.description: Financial services ecosystem offering a debit card, US bank account and remittance wallet, aimed at immigrants.
segments.evidence: The Company's developing Fintech Business Line offers a complete Fintech ecosystem including a MasterCard Debit Card, US Bank Account (No SSN Needed), and a Mobile App/Wallet for remittances and mobile top-up services.

segments.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI) division
segments.description: Enterprise and telecom AI software, including AI agents for web, voice and contact center use.
segments.evidence: Reality Border currently serves as IQSTEL's AI innovation and product development platform.

revenueModel.text: Telecom operators and carriers pay for wholesale voice termination and fiber network capacity, and businesses pay for voice services.
revenueModel.evidence: Etelix provides International Long-Distance voice services for Telecommunications Operators (ILD Wholesale), and Submarine Fiber Optic Network capacity for internet (4G and 5G).
